limitations.note: Instead of correcting the two 1-yuan transitions (`S1 → S2` and `S1_5 → S2_5`), the rewrite also changed how coin inputs are counted, registered the previously combinational outputs, and added a queue for multi-cycle change.

The testbench required outputs to stay unchanged before each rising edge and generated expected values from the same new coin-edge and change-queue rules, so its pass did not verify that the fix preserved the original FSM’s observable behavior.
